unique_groups.statement: For a projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, analytification is compact Hausdorff, and every line bundle’s canonical trivial metric and global section norms into [0,1] are continuous.

For a projective variety over an algebraically closed field, N^1(X) is finite dimensional, the ample cone is open, and the big cone is the interior of the closed cone generated by effective R-Cartier divisor classes.

unique_groups.statement: On a normal projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, if B is an actual rational bundle, E an effective rational Cartier divisor, and φ a generically finite Fubini–Study function in B satisfying φ≤log||s_E||+O(1), dividing its sections yields an all-point Fubini–Study function in B−E, equal to φ−log||s_E|| away from E (BJ v4, Lemma 2.23).

On a projective scheme over a complete non-Archimedean field, including trivial valuation, every psh metric on a semiample rational bundle in BE’s fixed-bundle sense admits decreasing smooth semipositive regularization; convergence to a continuous endpoint is uniform (BE v3, Theorem 7.14).
unique_groups.quote: Every psh metric φ on a semiample Q-line bundle L is psh-regularizable.

unique_groups.statement: On an n-dimensional projective scheme over a complete valued field, continuous psh-regularizable rational-bundle metrics have unique symmetric multiadditive positive mixed Radon products of fundamental-cycle intersection mass, continuous from uniform to weak convergence. These products extend independently of decomposition to continuous dpsh metrics as symmetric multilinear signed Radon products (BE v3, Theorem 8.4, Proposition 8.5 and the extension preceding Example 8.11).
